FIRE AFTERMATH

 📍QUEZON CITY - April 25, 2026 — Caution tape from the Bureau of Fire Protection surrounds the gutted stalls of the Commonwealth Market after a fifth-alarm fire razed sections of the market before dawn, leaving extensive damage but no reported fatalities.

📸: Edd Castro
